description: 1N5817 Schottky rectifier (20 V, 1 A): low forward drop, the usual charge-pump doubler diode (our fit to Diotec's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

fit.figure: Forward characteristics (typical values), Tj = 25 °C (read from the PDF's vector drawing, centre of the drawn line), up to about 3 A
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point, the curve's last point always included; IS held under the sheet's 1 mA leakage limit at VRRM; CJO is the sheet's typical 80 pF (at 4 V); no breakdown modelled
fit.note: The figure starts at 10 mA; below that the fit follows the diode equation, not the sheet. Diotec's part is slower than Diodes Incorporated's (0.75 V max at 3 A against Diodes' 0.45 V at 1 A; the fit reads about 0.58 V at 1 A); Diodes' curves are a raster image from 0.1 A, so Diotec's are the ones fitted
